item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem: Meera is packing her lunch for school on a hot summer afternoon. Which choice best supports healthy eating?

options.A: A very large serving of fresh, wholesome rice and dal, because wholesome food is always healthy in any amount
options.B: A moderate portion of fresh vegetable pulao with curd, suited to the hot weather and her afternoon mealtime
options.C: A brightly coloured packet of fried chips and a sweet drink, because the colourful meal looks attractive
options.D: Her favourite tasty sweets only, because familiar and tasty food is always a healthy choice
